name: album-cover-director
description: Create release-ready album covers where the title becomes a physical world, spatial event, or one hierarchy with a central figure.

interface.longDescription: Turns an exact title, with optional lyrics, project-local artist information, and supplied reference images, into cover directions built around material title-worlds, spatial fields, or character-led title systems; generates and evaluates artwork; applies dedicated release-identity and title-image gates; and prepares square delivery assets.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $album-cover-director to create three image-native title-system cover directions from this title and any optional lyrics, artist information, or reference images.
